title: Salisá My Quiet Bible
description: My Quiet Bible ezali ofele mpo na bato nyonso, libela. Soki ezali kosalisa yo, okoki kosalisa mpo mwinda etikala kongɛnga.
sub: Ofele mpo na bato nyonso, libela. Soki ezali kosalisa yo, okoki kosalisa mpo mwinda etikala kongɛnga.
kofiSub: Mbala moko, to sanza nyonso. Na kartɛ, Apple Pay to Google Pay, kokomisa nkombo te.
leave: Ekofungwama na lokasa ya sika. Zonga awa, to na Biblia, ntango osilisi.
btcSub: On-chain to Lightning, mbala moko na serveur na biso moko, kozanga moto ya katikati to moto mosusu.
btcAddressQr: Kɔdi QR ya adrɛsi ya Bitcoin
where:
• Ba-serveur oyo esalisaka bokokanisi mpe masanga etambola.
  • Bankombo ya domɛni, mpo myquietbible.com etikala kosala.
  • Imɛli oyo etindaka bakɔdi ya kokɔta.
never: Eloko moko te na Biblia ekokangama ata mokolo moko. Kopesa ezali matɔndi, kasi tikɛ ya kokɔta te, mpe eloko moko te ebongwanaka na application soki opesi to opesi te.
tax: My Quiet Bible ezali lisanga ya bolingo oyo ekomami na Leta te, yango wana makabo ekitisaka mpako na yo te.
other:
• Bondelá mpo na mosala oyo, mpe mpo na bato oyo batángaka na yango.
  • Tindá myquietbible.com epai ya moto oyo akolinga Biblia ya kimya.
